items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Helen says, aren't you going to play anything?

ctx.x: Helen says, aren't you going to play anything? So he said, sure, and he played. So in the next number he played two, three choruses, and it was very good, you know, a little more -- he used to play like Earl, but now he plays more like Teddy Wilson. But it's a strange story.
